name: scratch-trap-tiles
_notes: Scratch: the two trap tiles on one floor. Columns 4-8 are cracked soil (`d`) and 9-12 cracked timber (`w`) with nothing under them, so the dashed span is a bridge that falls into the pit a body stood on it; columns 16-18 are a one-tile pit with three spring pads at the bottom of it. `render --action run` shows both: the deck goes out from under the runner's back foot and the pads throw it out of the pit and into the flag. For out/trap-tiles.png.
